sun.security.ssl

类 SSLLogger

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.security.ssl.SSLLogger

  • public final class SSLLogger
extends Object
    Implementation of SSL logger. If the system property "javax.net.debug" is not defined, the debug logging is turned off. If the system property "javax.net.debug" is defined as empty, the debug logger is specified by System.getLogger("javax.net.ssl"), and applications can customize and configure the logger or use external logging mechanisms. If the system property "javax.net.debug" is defined and non-empty, a private debug logger implemented in this class is used.
